{{Top|leg}}
The '''ANs-9.5w wide range sensor system''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] system manufactured by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]]. The ANs-9.5w was used by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] on the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]].
